text:
Leah (Finance): Alert: Azure Marketplace settlement shows reseller tier discounts not applied for ResellerCorp on invoice AZR-2028-08-14. Overbilled amount reported by partner = $9,125. Need root cause and fix before month close.

Owen (Billing): Can you paste the offending lines?

Leah (Finance): Sample lines (redacted):
```
Invoice: AZR-2028-08-14
Line: marketplace:eu-north-1:resellercorp:high-cpu  Units: 1200  ChargeUSD: 18,250.00  reseller_id: ResellerCorp
Line: marketplace:eu-north-1:resellercorp:baseline-storage Units: 1  ChargeUSD: 1,125.00  reseller_id: resellercorp
```
Note: partner says they should have a 25% tier discount on High-CPU SKU applied at >1000 units. Charges look full-rate. Also suspicious that reseller_id casing differs (ResellerCorp vs resellercorp).

Pri (Partner Ops): ResellerCorp reported this morning. They sent their monthly metering export; their reseller_id values use uppercase R/C occasionally. Our partner onboarding sheet lists canonical id as "resellercorp" lowercase. I flagged case-sensitivity concerns in past but assumed normalization existed.

Diego (Sales): We promised ResellerCorp automatic tiering for volume. They're upset and asked for an immediate corrective credit. They want confirmation before sending public complaint to AWS account team.

Maya (Engineering): Quick check: transform.marketplace normalizes provider reseller_id to lowercase in most paths, but the tiering engine reads the raw reseller_id from the pre-transform payload for lookup. Code snippet from logs: `INFO billing.tiering - lookup reseller by id=ResellerCorp -> not_found`

recon-bot: Automated scan: Potential overcharge total = $9,125.00 on AZR-2028-08-14. Likely cause: inconsistent reseller_id normalization between transform and tiering lookup. Suggested actions: 1) reprocess with normalized ids 2) if time-constrained, post temporary credit journal.

Owen (Billing): If Eng can re-run transform to normalize reseller_id before tiering, the tier lookup should apply and regenerate credits. Otherwise we'll need to post journal JRN-2028-08-16-102 for the credit. Leah, do you authorize a temporary credit journal up to $10k if reprocess isn't done in time?

Leah (Finance): Approve up to $10k temporary credit for ResellerCorp pending reprocess. Tag memo "mp-tier-credit-temp" and reference AZR-2028-08-14.

Maya (Engineering): I'll open a PR to canonicalize reseller_id early in the pipeline and add a unit test. I can run a backfill for 08-12 to 08-15 in our staging reprocess window. ETA 2 hours to PR + 1 hour to reprocess + validation.

Pri (Partner Ops): I'll notify ResellerCorp that we're investigating and have authorized a temporary credit if needed. Ask them to hold on public escalation for 48 hours.

Diego (Sales): I'll also send a short note offering a provisional credit while we fix it so they don't escalate.

Maya (Engineering): PR merged. Kicking off reprocess job rp-normalize-220 now. Will post status.

recon-bot: Reprocess job rp-normalize-220 started. Monitoring: https://billing.internal/jobs/rp-normalize-220

recon-bot: Reprocess complete (rp-normalize-220). Results: Tiering applied correctly after reseller_id normalized. Systems calculated partner credit = $9,125.00 and created offsetting negative credit lines. 100% of disputed amount matched and tagged. Reconciliation link: https://billing.internal/recon/AZR-2028-08-14/rp-normalize-220

Owen (Billing): Verified the regenerated credit lines and ledger adjustments. No manual journal needed. We'll include the credit on next settlement cycle.

Pri (Partner Ops): ResellerCorp confirmed credits visible in their partner portal. They asked for a brief postmortem and permanent fix.

Leah (Finance): Great. Please still add a short runbook entry describing the normalization requirement and the reprocess steps. Also add an alert when tiering lookup fails for >0.1% of invoice lines.

Maya (Engineering): Will add runbook note and a small metric in our billing dashboard to monitor tier lookup failures. I'll also add a unit test to prevent regressions.

Diego (Sales): ResellerCorp is satisfied with the fix and the provisional communication. Closing on my side.

Leah (Finance): Closing thread: resolved by reprocess and system fix. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
